meta_description: Wythenshawe Manchester Gardener specialises in landscape design, garden maintenance, and planting. Local, reliable service. Call for a free quote today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Landscape Gardener — Wythenshawe & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Whether you need a complete garden redesign or regular maintenance, we'll bring your vision to life in Wythenshawe.
services_subhead: From initial design through to ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of your garden so you can enjoy it.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke landscape designs tailored to your space and style. We handle everything from initial concept through to full installation, creating gardens that are both beautiful and practical.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular lawn care, hedge trimming, and border upkeep keep your garden looking its best year-round. We work to your schedule, whether weekly, fortnightly, or seasonal visits.

services.title: Patio & Pathway Installation
services.desc: Quality stone and paving work that transforms your garden into a functional outdoor space. We ensure proper drainage and use materials that stand up to the Manchester weather.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert plant selection and installation for year-round colour and structure. We choose species suited to your soil and sunlight, and establish them properly for long-term growth.

services.title: Lawn Restoration & Seeding
services.desc: Tired patchy grass? We aerate, scarify, and reseed to restore healthy turf. New lawns established from seed or turf, with aftercare advice included.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Tidy-Ups
services.desc: One-off clearance for overgrown gardens, or regular tidy visits to keep things under control. We remove all waste responsibly and leave your space clean and ready.

about_pullquote: I'd rather do five gardens brilliantly than fifty halfheartedly.
about_para_1: Based in Wythenshawe, I've been creating and maintaining beautiful gardens across Manchester for over a decade. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local service, but the ethos remains the same: listen to what you want, deliver it properly, and turn up on time.
about_para_2: Your garden should be somewhere you actually want to spend time. That's why I focus on practical, realistic designs that suit your lifestyle and budget—not magazine spreads that wilt come July. Many of my customers have been with me for years, and that loyalty means everything.
reviews_heading: What Wythenshawe Gardeners Say About Us

reviews.text: Our back garden was an absolute mess—weeds everywhere, nothing in shape. Got a quote from the lad in Wythenshawe and he sorted it all out in two weeks. New patio, new plants, the lot. Looks completely different now. Top bloke, fair prices, turned up when he said he would.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Been using him for regular maintenance for about three years now. Comes every three weeks during the growing season, keeps the lawn and borders looking immaculate. Never had to chase him or worry about quality. Honestly, best garden service I've found.
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text: Wanted something low-maintenance but still nice to look at. He helped me understand what would actually work in our space and delivered a proper design. Installed it himself, explained the planting plan, and the garden's thriving. Couldn't have asked for better.
reviews.author: Robert K.
